title: German Quinoa Wrap
description: A healthy and flavorful German-inspired quinoa wrap filled with sautéed veggies and a tangy sauce.
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package instructions.
Sauté chopped onion, carrots, and cucumber in a pan with a little oil until tender.
Add diced tomato and cook for another 2 minutes.
Warm the wrap in the microwave for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spreading yummy sauce on the wrap, followed by the cooked quinoa and the sautéed veggies.
Fold the wrap and serve immediately.
